native_pssr_scene_scale.status: Offline-verified candidate; actual main-race PSSR inputs and image quality require game validation
native_pssr_scene_scale.method: Override the native scene controller endpoints to 0.5; preserve Pro quantization, target sizing, viewport setup and native Psml/PSSR dispatch
native_pssr_scene_scale.offline_evidence: 686 controller/Pro-quantizer/target-size cases produce 1920x1080 for a standard 3840x2160 Pro scene; native target descriptor and viewport setters tested separately
native_pssr_scene_scale.caveats: Standard main-scene sizing only. Special viewports, per-scene multipliers and secondary targets may differ. Native color/depth/motion dimensions, jitter and scales remain supplied by the game, never replaced with nominal metadata. Does not force physical allocation size, LOD, shadows or Sony PSSR2 execution. DLSS reconstructs the native PSSR inputs; frame generation is disabled.
